summary: User accumulated 5.13 BTC and stored it using a seed generated on a COLDCARD Mk3 in 2021 with physical seed backups and device timelocks. After learning of the COLDCARD security issue the user attempted to access the backup to move the funds but the bitcoin was drained before recovery was possible.
prevention: Move funds promptly after a confirmed vulnerability affects the device that generated the wallet seed / Maintain a recovery setup that permits timely emergency access
